evidence_labels.development: DEVELOPMENT_PSEUDO_OOS; screening evidence, not pristine holdout

release_lag_policy.conservative: standard plus 15 days; zero-lag daily sources use 3 days

predictor_eligibility.primary: at least 60 observed months, usable by 2019-12, no unresolved failure
predictor_eligibility.secondary: at least 24 observed months or a documented proxy/short history
predictor_eligibility.diagnostic_only: less than 24 observations or material timing/quality concern
predictor_eligibility.ineligible: no usable transformed observations or quarterly target

rules.missing_data: preserve missing values; never impute model inputs; model forecast is unavailable when its required target-origin lags are unavailable
rules.transformation_rules: use registry clean_model_field without performance-driven changes

ranking_metrics.primary: matched-sample pooled H1-H3 RMSE versus frozen production

rules.promotion_rules: Phase 5C permits REJECT, RETAIN_FOR_RESEARCH, SHADOW_CHALLENGER, STRONG_SHADOW_CHALLENGER only; production promotion is forbidden
multiple_testing_safeguards: one or two predictors per economic block where feasible
rules.combination_weight_rule: performance weights at each origin use only earlier realized quarters; non-negative weights normalized to one
